language_policy.source_content: Preserve original source language. Do not translate.

source_envelope.text: The only embedding input at source level. Includes a compact title/context prefix where appropriate. Final chunk text is used after chunking.
source_envelope.text_sha256: SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 text field.
source_envelope.metadata: Separate provenance and evidence role. Do not serialize this object into embedding text.

actual_source_example.text:
Title: Make Streamlit more friendly to multi-threading
Evidence role: Historical feature request: proposed APIs are not evidence of implemented behavior.

### Summary

Streamlit doesn't currently tackle multi-threading as a core feature and leads to some undefined behavior when used (ex: empty session state). 

### Why?

**Related issue submissions:**
#1906 
#7290 
#7655

metadata.title: Make Streamlit more friendly to multi-threading
metadata.usage_constraint: Historical feature request: proposed APIs are not evidence of implemented behavior.

scope_review.rationale: Retains a Session State report or directly related widget/callback/rerun/page/test interaction; report is evidence of a problem, not proof of a correct cause or fix.

fields.chunk_id: Stable ID computed from source_id, source text hash, chunker configuration hash, and chunk index.
fields.text: Exact source text slice with code fences preserved; the only payload submitted for embedding.
fields.metadata: Inherited source metadata plus chunk offsets, source text hash, and chunker configuration hash.
fields.text_sha256: SHA-256 of the final chunk text.

future_chunk_contract.offset_basis: Character offsets into the delivered source envelope text, not original GitHub bodies or archived rubric span bodies.

proposed_starting_configuration.tokenizer: Choose with the embedding model; not selected in this delivery.
proposed_starting_configuration.oversized_code_block_policy: Prefer a standalone code chunk within the chosen model limit. If a split is required, retain enough context and explicit continuation metadata.
proposed_starting_configuration.tuning_policy: Tune on development cases only; freeze configuration before test execution.

future_chunk_contract.identity_warning: Chunk indices alone are unstable after source edits. Include source/configuration hashes in chunk identity.

approval_policy.approved_text_rule: config approved_text preserves the v03 exact selected source substring. The delivered v04 text applies audited nontechnical cleanup after selection; it need not remain a contiguous source substring. Preserve claims, uncertainty and code, and validate via audit/text_cleanup_v04.jsonl.
approval_policy.corroborated_claim_rule: A narrow claim must have an exact supporting official snapshot span and a version-applicability note.
approval_policy.media_rule: For a media-containing candidate, media_independence must equal selected_excerpt_is_self_contained_without_media.

evidence_interpretation.issue: An unverified reported problem, observation, or proposal; not a verified solution.
evidence_interpretation.comment: Use according to the recorded AI review role and limitation. Reported observations, diagnoses and proposed workarounds are not independently executed fixes.
evidence_interpretation.documentation: Official snapshot; check applicability to the user version.
evidence_interpretation.release_section: Official change for its explicit version/date; check that it addresses the claim.

evaluation_boundary.future_turns: Evaluator-only; release a due message after the specified prior assistant response.
evaluation_boundary.gold: Never add evaluator rubrics, full held-out threads, or audit snapshots to the retrieval index.
evaluation_boundary.access_control: The runner must enforce path access. The loader allowlist is not OS isolation.

provenance_hashes.body_sha256: Normalized source body hash where provided.
provenance_hashes.text_sha256: Transformed delivered source envelope text hash.
provenance_hashes.rubric_offsets: Offsets into archived canonical documentation body; do not apply directly to retrieval or chunk text.

project_budget.next_cost_gate: Count selected text with the chosen tokenizer and measure a small pilot using actual Metis rates and remaining balance; do not re-embed unchanged text.

source_volume.tokenizer_selection: Deferred until model selection; characters/words are volume measurements, not token counts or cost guarantees.

text_preparation.code_policy: Fenced and inline backtick code tokens are byte-for-byte equal to the v03 selected text. Code is not executed. Technical names and URLs remain.
text_preparation.archives: Original audit snapshots and historical review decisions remain unmodified and must never be indexed.

link_handling.review_scope: Markdown and bare references outside fenced/inline code in the v04 selected text. Code URLs remain protected examples, not crawled. First-hop review only; newly added pages are not recursively crawled.
link_handling.embedding_rule: Embed only text. Preserve link relations and source dates/versions in chunk metadata; do not embed audit reports or serialize relation metadata into source text.
link_handling.retrieval_rule: A runtime retriever must explicitly select linked neighbors when useful; a stored URL is not destination content.
link_handling.historical_source_rule: Preserve issue/comment dates and pinned commits; a fresh documentation excerpt is not evidence of behavior in an older reported version.
